body:
ok so a friend of mine says she knows this guy who has pills full of something that will make me 'trip' at the time i was on the hunt hard for mushrooms and this seemed like a feesable alternative well i picked up 2 4mg pills and took them both at the same time, about an hour and a half after taking them i started to feel very sick and dissy that subsided about a half hour later and what followed was SCARY my boddy felt like it was shivering uncontrollably and i felt terribly cold but everyone i was with at the time said i was burning up ans sweating, i felt like i could barely move and nothing i saw seemed right from a simple tree to the at the time orange clouds, this all lasted about 10 hours that i will never forget, this experience prompted me to research this 5meo-amt and apparentlly i was very lucky and will never take lightly something like this again.
